title: Tilted docs tour with a travelling focus band
summary: A dark product UI leaned back in 3D, the camera trucking slowly and linearly across it while a narrow focus band sits on one element per shot; eight UI shots, then a flat mark and a flat wordmark.
use_when: A developer tool or docs product whose UI is the story and there is no VO
Calm, premium product tour where reading speed matters more than energy
Several UI states (landing, article, search, API page) to show in under 25 s
Dark UI with one accent colour that survives heavy vignetting

look.type_style: UI grotesk, sentence case, small (page titles ~3 % H, body ~1.5 % H); end wordmark medium weight, sentence case, ~4 % H, light grey

sfx.event: characters typed into the search field and the card input
cursor clicks the primary button on the API page
flat mark appears after the last UI shot

structure.shot: docs landing: nav bar, product wordmark title, two-line intro, two blue feature cards with captions, plane leaned back
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX ~15-25 deg; no pan (0.1 px/fr decaying); push-in 1.000 -> 1.034 over 93 fr (+1.1 %/s), easings.linear
structure.motion: no element motion; focus band on the middle third (79 vs 10-11 edge sharpness), plane static apart from the creep

structure.shot: sidebar nav with active item plus an overview article: two-line heading and two body paragraphs
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX + rotateY, baseline rises ~8 deg; dolly left 2.4 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 110 fr; scale +0.6 %/s; roll +0.4 deg/s
structure.motion: no element motion; focus band across the heading and sidebar

structure.shot: close on an explainer diagram card under a section heading: blue node box, document icon, connector lines, small chips
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateY ~-25 deg, rotateX ~15-20 deg; dolly up 2.4 px/fr @1920 with push-in 1.00 -> 1.12 over 135 fr (+2.7 %/s); speed 2.68 / 2.47 / 2.18 px/fr by thirds, easings.outQuint; roll +0.5 deg/s
structure.motion: no element motion; focus band on the diagram, near rows below blurred

structure.shot: page title with a two-line subtitle and an install section, cursor resting near a copy button
structure.camera: tilt-plane; dolly right 2.0 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 37 fr
structure.motion: cursor drifts toward the top bar, easings.linear (±0.25 s); very shallow focus: middle 12x sharper than edges

structure.shot: search popup over the dimmed page: recent results list, then a query typed letter by letter and the result list refills
structure.camera: tilt-plane; dolly right 1.9 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 90 fr; scale ~0
structure.motion: popup opens at 12.50 (±0.25 s, spring not measurable); typing starts 13.77, 5 characters by 14.50, typewriter ~6 cps; results swap per keystroke, hard swap (±0.25 s); bottom third fully out of focus

structure.shot: section heading over a recipe card grid; an input inside the first card fills with a short question
structure.camera: tilt-plane, strong lean, far edge top; dolly left 1.1 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 125 fr
structure.motion: typewriter in the card input from 16.00 to 19.25, ~7 words, ~10 cps with a caret; focus band on the card (217 vs 8/92), far edge blurred hardest

structure.shot: API reference page: endpoint list in the sidebar, endpoint title, method pill, primary button, code sample panel on the right
structure.camera: tilt-plane; dolly left 2.2 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 52 fr
structure.motion: cursor travels to the primary button by 20.27 and clicks at ~20.50 (±0.25 s); cursor-path, springs.click on press (overshoot not measurable); wider focus band

structure.shot: same API page closer: request panel with an error response and the code sample, cursor parked
structure.camera: tilt-plane, punched in ~1.4x on the same move: dolly left 2.1 px/fr @1920, easings.linear, 36 fr
structure.motion: no element motion; focus on the request panel (553 vs 60-154)

structure.shot: flat white brand mark centred on near-black, ~8 % H
structure.motion: appears on the cut, holds 80 fr, no entrance

structure.shot: flat light-grey wordmark centred on near-black, ~4 % H
structure.motion: appears on the cut, holds 124 fr to the end, no entrance or exit

params.brand: any brand.json: dark bg, fg, one accent for active items and buttons, display font for the wordmark
params.content.screens: 6-8 UI screens (React nodes or rebuilt pages), each with a focus target (0-1 along the plane) and a dolly vector
params.content.searchQuery: short query typed into the search popup, ~5 characters
params.content.cardPrompt: short question typed into a card input, ~7 words
params.content.clickTarget: element on the API screen the cursor clicks
params.timing.shots: seconds per UI shot (default 3.1, 3.67, 4.5, 1.23, 3.0, 4.17, 1.73, 1.2); action shots short, reading shots long
params.truckSpeed: px per frame at 1920 wide (default 2.2, range 1.1-2.7)
params.focusBand: TiltPlane dof band width (default 0.24) and edge blur (default 8-10)

notes: Zero detected cuts: the scene detector missed every cut because the frames are dark; boundaries are from sheet cells and the frame-by-frame notes (near misses at 3.10, 6.77, 11.27, 15.50, 19.67). Every UI shot trucks at constant speed (1.1-2.7 px/fr at 1920); never a static UI frame. Focus band is narrow (middle third 3-12x sharper than the edges) and placed on the shot's subject. Shots 7 and 8 are a punch-in on the same move vector, so they read as one camera. Roll drift 0.3-0.5 deg/s. Heavy vignette. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): focus-band, vector-punch-in, flat-mark-card. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
